summary.text: Jeremy Faison is a Republican state representative from Cosby representing Tennessee House District 11 (Cocke and part of Hamblen and Jefferson Counties), a member of the 107th through 114th General Assemblies. He is Majority Caucus Chairman and chairs the Joint Judiciary and Government committee.

paragraphs.text: Faison was born on September 14, 1976, in Monroe, Georgia, and is a small business owner with Rocky Top Pest Control.
He is married to Miriam; they have five children and one grandchild.

His page lists service as past president of the Cocke County Republicans, board membership at Douglas Cooperative and the Mountain View Youth Development Center, and a role as worship leader at Crossroads Community Church.
In the House he also sits on the Calendar & Rules, Commerce, Finance, Ways, and Means, and Government Operations committees.
